property_summary: For any caller address that is approved via setApprovedLogger(addr,true), calling logCreated(keep) always emits the Created event and returns true on the correct contract; the mutant always returns false even for an approved logger, so there exists input (an approved logger address) that breaks this return-value property.
change_summary: Always emit the event but always return false regardless of approval status (change return to false unconditionally).
